dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer shows the street rights-of-way in Newton, Massachusetts. The features in this data layer come from the PARCELS data layer.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. More advanced user applications may focus on urban and regional planning, transportation analysis and planning, and other associated themes.

Supplemental information: There are no arc or polygon attributes other than the standard ones created for an Arc/Info coverage. This data layer is updated by periodically repeating the process described in the Data Quality section of this record. Maintenance is only required when new streets are created or the layout of existing streets changes.
